scope: Bounded original-region decode and shared encoded source foundation; not yet canonical display/worker page integration.

source_contract.orientation: original top-left pixel coordinates; no scaling or source-tile address changes
source_contract.base64: seekable decoded-byte view over existing original text; <=3072 temporary decoded bytes per read chunk
